title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: The black-clad figure pursued relentlessly, blade strikes fierce and merciless—Chen Ji had nowhere to retreat—yet at the critical threshold between life and death, a faint glow suddenly emanated from his wrist, a familiar Demonic Path aura slicing through the night sky...

text.content:
Night was as black as ink. Chen Ji sat cross-legged in the Servants' Quarters, fingertips caressing the Jade Slip Ye Qing had sent through an intermediary. As his spiritual sense probed within, information trickled into his mind like a gentle stream—the Elder had frequently visited the Rear Mountain Forbidden Grounds these past days, secretly meeting a mysterious figure several times, with the timing coinciding precisely after the Five Elders' Council.

He slowly opened his eyes, cold gleam flickering and vanishing in an instant. "External forces..." The murmured words echoed through the silent room, a cold smile curling at his lips. No wonder the Five Elders'布局 was so meticulous—it turned out the murky waters of Tianqing Sect harbored an outsider, a catfish hidden within.

dialogue.content: "If the intel is real, this fish is quite a big one." Ye Qing's voice suddenly sounded outside the window, her black silhouette flashing into the room like a specter. Tonight she wore no Holy Sect Saintess brocade, only a set of night raid attire, a light veil concealing half her face, leaving only a pair of cold, indifferent eyes gleaming with an eerie light in the darkness.

Chen Ji didn't even glance up, his voice calm: "The Saintess visits in the dead of night—aren't you afraid of being seen, and accusations that Tianqing Sect's menial servants are colluding with the Demonic Path?"

Ye Qing snorted coldly, producing another Jade Slip from her sleeve and tossing it over: "I've had my people investigate the Elder's secret contact—a trace of their background has been found—it involves Xuanwu Sect."

text.content:
Chen Ji accepted the Jade Slip, his spiritual sense probing within. His pupils suddenly contracted. The slip contained not only the secret meeting times and locations between the Elder and the Xuanwu Sect visitor, but also a fragmentary copy of a letter—the seal at the end, he recognized.

It was the same emblem he had often seen in his father's study.

dialogue.content:
"I've looked into your father's matter." Ye Qing seemed to sense his unusual reaction, her voice slightly lowered. "The accident twelve years ago may not have been an accident. Chen Ji, prepare yourself."

Chen Ji remained silent for a long while. When he finally raised his eyes, his expression had returned to its usual calm, even a faint smile at his lips: "The Saintess's intelligence is quite valuable. What do you want in return?"

"The Scripture Vault." Ye Qing stated it bluntly. "Every time after the Elder's secret meetings, he spends an hour or two in the Scripture Vault—there must be more core evidence there. My people cannot enter, but you can—as a Servant Disciple on night patrol, that provides the perfect cover."

She paused, a complex light flickering in her gaze: "After this deal, we'll be even."

text.content:
Chen Ji toyed with the Jade Slip, feigning indifference: "Even? The Saintess overestimates yourself. Since my father's clues are connected to this matter, I would investigate eventually—you merely gave it a convenient push."

Ye Qing's brow arched slightly, her expression caught between a smile and a frown: "Then forget I said it. At the third watch of the night, the west side door of the Scripture Vault—I've left the key at the usual spot." Before the words even faded, her form had turned to black smoke and vanished into the night.

Night grew deeper. Chen Ji, dressed in a gray cloth servant's robe, moved through the winding corridors of Tianqing Sect. The moonlight was obscured by dark clouds, and the entire sect lay shrouded in gloom. He deliberately slowed his pace, his breathing and吐纳 adjusted to its most subtle state, even his heartbeat seemingly coming to a halt.

The outline of the Scripture Vault appeared ahead—three-story flying eaves, carved beams and painted rafters, yet tonight it carried an eerie stillness.

A copper key was indeed placed at the side door. Chen Ji silently retrieved it and pushed the door open. Inside the vault, the scent of aged paper and sandalwood mingled together. Rows of bookshelves stood like silent giants between them. He did not rush to search; instead, he closed his eyes and slowly released his spiritual sense—the Elder's lingering presence, extending from the second-floor study all the way to the underground level.

Underground? Chen Ji's eyes flickered with subtle light as his footsteps silently headed toward the staircase.

The basement entrance was hidden behind a row of bookshelves. Chen Ji used the key to activate the mechanism, and the stone door heavily slid open a crack. A damp, musty气息 rushed out, carrying with it an extremely faint... medicinal fragrance?

He frowned slightly—such an odor was all too familiar to him—the residual scent left only when crafting forbidden elixirs. Tianqing Sect explicitly prohibited crafting forbidden elixirs, yet the Elder was secretly doing so?

Stone steps extended downward. Chen Ji descended one step at a time, darkness swallowing him like a tide.

The basement was vaster than anticipated. Several dim夜明珠 were inlaid into the stone walls, barely illuminating a black sandalwood desk in the center. Several letters lay scattered on the desk, the wax seal of the topmost one already torn away, but traces remained.

Chen Ji picked up the letter and unfolded it. His gaze swept across the contents, his pupils suddenly tightening—the letter mentioned "Chen Family Old Artifacts," "Tianji Fragment," and a name that nearly froze the blood in his veins: his father's style name.

dialogue.content:
"Do you see it?" Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang in his mind, aged and deep. "Your father's handwriting—he did not fall to an accident back then, but was deliberately framed. The scheme twelve years ago runs deeper than you can imagine."

The fingers holding the letter trembled slightly, then steadied. His voice was terrifyingly calm: "The one who framed him—was it the Elder? Or someone else?"

"The Elder is merely one of the pieces." Mo Xiansheng's words rang like echoes from an abyss. "The true Chess Player lies far beyond Tianqing Sect. Xuanwu Sect's involvement confirms my suspicions—this is a vast net, and you, Chen Ji, have been caught in it since birth."

Chen Ji tucked the letter into his sleeve, his gaze falling upon a dusty wooden box in the corner of the desk. The moment his fingertips touched the lid, a familiar scent invaded his senses—the sandalwood his father frequently used.

text.content:
Inside the wooden box lay several yellowed pages, characters faded but still legible. Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the surging emotions in his heart and quickly browsed through them—it was a transaction agreement! The Elder had traded a secret technique of Tianqing Sect for Xuanwu Sect in exchange for cultivation support for his son Lin Xiao, and the price of the transaction was exactly what the Chen Family had once guarded.

"Tianji Fragment..." Chen Ji murmured these four words, his knuckles turning white with pressure. So this was it! His father guarded the Tianji Record, yet the Elder coveted this object, thus colluding with foreign enemies to design this massacre!

A chilling killing intent flickered across his eyes, then was forcibly suppressed. Not yet. Not the time.

choice.prompt: At this moment, soft footsteps echoed from the basement entrance—someone was coming! Chen Ji had to decide immediately:

choices.text: Quickly hide in a concealed spot
choices.description: Hide his form among the complex corners of the basement, observe whether the approaching person was friend or foe, then decide the next move.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the evidence, seize the opportunity to understand the enemy's movements
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, he will lose his retreat route

text.content: Chen Ji's form flashed, darting into the shadows behind a stone pillar, converging all his aura to an almost imperceptible state. The stone door was pushed open, and two figures entered the basement one after another—firelight illuminating their faces. It was the Elder and a black-robed figure.

choices.description: Seize the distant footsteps, immediately take the agreement and leave, firmly grasping the evidence in hand. Safety first—the intelligence is already sufficient.
choices.visible_reward: Holding irrefutable evidence, one can strike back in the future
choices.risk_hint: If pursued, will fall into danger

text.content: Chen Ji stuffed the contract and wooden box into his chest, his toes touching the ground as he was about to leave through the passage on the other side. However, the sound of the stone door opening came faster than he anticipated—the footsteps were already close at hand.

choices.description: Since the other party clearly bears ill intentions, one might as well show oneself proactively, using the waste identity to gather intelligence and see how much they actually know.
choices.visible_reward: Gather more intelligence, ascertain the enemy's trump cards
choices.risk_hint: If the enemy's strength far exceeds imagination, it will lead to irretrievable ruin

text.content: Chen Ji did not hide at all. Instead, he straightened his collar and stood calmly beside the table, his face wearing the usual timid expression. The footsteps stopped at the end of the stone steps. Amid the flickering firelight, the Law Enforcement Elder's silhouette appeared at the doorway—and behind him was a mysterious figure entirely shrouded in black fog.

The Law Enforcement Elder's gaze swept through the underground chamber like lightning, and when it landed on the wooden box in Chen Ji's hand, his expression drastically changed: "You—!"

The black-robed figure let out a low, chilling laugh, his voice hoarse like withered leaves rubbing together: "Interesting. A servant disciple, yet able to find his way here. It seems the one chosen by the Tianji Record is indeed no ordinary person."

Chen Ji's heart lurched violently, but his face showed only a bewildered, panicked expression as he stammered: "Third, Third Elder, this disciple only... only got lost during night patrol..."

dialogue.content:
The black-robed figure advanced slowly, the black mist swirling around him emanating a suffocating pressure: "Lost? The door to the Scripture Repository's underground chamber requires a special key. How did a servant disciple obtain it?"

He reached out, his withered fingers aiming directly for Chen Ji's throat, the speed almost impossible to react to. Chen Ji's pupils constricted, his body instinctively leaning backward—just as the fingertips touched his collar, a burst of black smoke exploded凭空, forcefully intercepting the black-robed figure's attack.

"Run!" Ye Qing's voice exploded beside his ear.

text.content:
Chen Ji felt an icy hand grip his waist, his body involuntarily dragged toward the side passage. Ye Qing's figure moved alongside him, their feet generating wind, clearly executing some form of short-distance teleportation technique. Behind them came the black-robed figure's furious roar and the Law Enforcement Elder's startled, uncertain shout: "Ye Qing?! How is she here?!"

The two figures rapidly shuttled through the darkness until, confirming they had shaken off their pursuers, they stopped in an abandoned alchemist's workshop.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing released her grip, fixing Chen Ji with an unfavorable stare: "Are you insane? Knowing the Law Enforcement Elder and that black-robed individual were present, you still dared to show yourself? If I hadn't prepared a contingency, you would have met your end tonight."

Chen Ji leaned against the wall, breathing heavily, his expression of terror gradually fading, replaced by a complex look. He raised his eyes to Ye Qing, his voice hoarse: "...Thank you."

This was the first time he had expressed gratitude to this Demon Path Saint.

Ye Qing was stunned for a moment, then snorted coldly and turned away: "Don't misunderstand. I simply didn't want to lose my cooperative partner before the deal is concluded. Did you sense that black-robed individual's aura?"

Chen Ji nodded, a hint of gravity flickering across his gaze: "Not from Xuanwu Sect. I've encountered Xuanwu Sect's techniques before, but there's no such... disgusting sensation."

He paused, his voice turning ice-cold: "That felt more like authentic Demon Path techniques, but even more obscure and sinister than the Holy Sect's aura."

Ye Qing's expression slightly changed, clearly recognizing the gravity of the issue: "Authentic Demon Path... that's an existence even older than the Holy Sect. The Law Enforcement Elder actually has connections with such a force? Chen Ji, the trouble you've provoked might be bigger than you imagined."

Chen Ji did not answer. He simply lowered his head to gaze at the wooden box in his hands, his thumb tracing his father's handwriting. After a long while, he quietly spoke: "Ye Qing, I remember you mentioning that your Demon Path mist can conceal aura?"

Ye Qing narrowed her eyes: "What are you planning?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then raised his head to meet Ye Qing's gaze, his eyes glinting with dangerous light.

choices.description: Tonight's disturbance has alerted the snake—they will certainly strengthen their vigilance. Better to lie low for a period and wait until the heat dies down before making plans. With evidence in hand, there's no urgency.
choices.visible_cost: The Law Enforcement Elder might destroy the evidence
choices.visible_reward: Preserve oneself and wait for a better opportunity
choices.risk_hint: Missing the opportunity might allow the enemy to escape

text.content: "No rush." Chen Ji tucked the wooden box into his chest, a cold smirk curling his lips. "Tonight, they saw my face—they will certainly investigate the Servants' Quarters. But they won't expect that I'm no longer alone. Law Enforcement Elder, search all you want—I'd like to see what you can find."

choices.description: Since the enemy already knows someone has stolen intelligence, why not turn the tables? Create false information to lure the snake out of its hole, and eliminate the Law Enforcement Elder and the forces behind him in one fell swoop.
choices.visible_cost: The risk is extremely high, potentially exposing all hidden cards.
choices.visible_reward: If successful, all threats can be eliminated at once.
choices.risk_hint: If it fails, it will be an irrevocable downfall.

text.content: "Disguise the real goal while achieving something unexpected." A cold, fierce light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. "The Third Elder is no fool—he will definitely find a way to silence us. Instead of waiting for him to strike first, we should make the first move—throw him into chaos."

choices.description: This matter exceeds our capabilities and requires assistance from higher authorities. Su Qingyao is the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow—if we can persuade her to intervene, perhaps we can leverage a greater shift in the situation.
choices.visible_cost: Expose our whereabouts to more people.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain powerful support and share the risks.
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao becomes suspicious, she may become a new variable.

text.content: "Su Qingyao..." Chen Ji murmured the name, the image of that cold, proud figure surfacing in his mind. Indeed, she was the only one who had noticed the clues, yet also the most trustworthy—as long as he was willing to risk revealing some truth.

Night Qing watched the swirling thoughts in Chen Ji's eyes, then suddenly laughed softly: "You truly are extraordinary. No wonder the Tianji Record chose you—such a mind that can still plot calmly even in desperate straits, indeed suitable to be a chess player."

Chen Ji did not deny it, merely saying calmly: "The Saint Lady overpraises. Tonight's matters, I will remember."

Night Qing raised an eyebrow: "Remember what?"

"Remember that you owe me." Chen Ji lifted his gaze, a dark light flickering in his eyes. "Two times of assistance—this debt, I will repay eventually."

dialogue.content:
Night Qing was momentarily speechless at these words, then snorted coldly: "Save the theatrics. Between you and me, it's merely a transaction—"

"Beyond the transaction, there is trust." Chen Ji interrupted her, his voice calm yet carrying an undeniable force. "In this world, those I would expose my back to are few—but the Saint Lady is one of them."

Night Qing froze for a moment, then turned away, her voice dropping: "...Say what you will. I'm leaving first—you'd better find somewhere else to stay before dawn."

text.content:
The black figure merged into the night once more, and the large alchemy room returned to silence. Chen Ji leaned against the wall, examining his gains by the faint moonlight—the contract, the wooden box, and his father's handwritten notes.

The "accident" twelve years ago indeed had hidden secrets. The Third Elder, the Xuanwu Sect, and that extraordinarily bizarre black-robed cultivator... The web they had woven was far vaster and more terrifying than he had imagined.

And he himself stood at the center of this web, with watching eyes on all sides.

Master Mo's voice rang out once more, carrying a rare gravity: "Boy, that person you encountered tonight—I recognize that black-robed cultivator's aura."

Chen Ji's spirits lifted: "Who is it?"

"An old friend from long ago... or rather, an old enemy." Master Mo's voice grew distant. "Your father, when he guarded the Tianji Record, wasn't guarding just this cultivation method—he was guarding a secret that could overturn the order of heaven itself. And those who covet this secret, from ancient times to now, have never ceased."

"Who are they...?"

Master Mo was silent for a moment, then uttered a name that sent chills down Chen Ji's spine: "The Eyes of Heavenly Way."

The Eyes of Heavenly Way—that existence Chen Ji had faintly sensed when he first obtained the Tianji Record—had actually infiltrated inside the Tianqing Sect!

He tightly gripped the wooden box in his hands, his knuckles white. His father's death, his mother's disappearance, his own useless persona, the Tianji Record's curse... all of it was a chess game set up by the "Eyes of Heavenly Way"?

No—he must not be clouded by rage. Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. The Eyes of Heavenly Way were indeed terrifying, but they would not act personally, at least not now. They were playing a much larger game, and he, Chen Ji, was merely a small piece within it.

But a piece can also capture the general.

Chen Ji slowly rose, his gaze through the broken window of the alchemy room fixed on the horizon. The dark clouds gradually dispersed, and a sliver of dawn pierced through the sky.

A new day was about to begin, and the storm was only beginning to brew.

He tucked the wooden box close to his body, straightened his robes, and the wooden, timid expression returned to his face. Servant Disciple Chen Ji should go back to being "bullied"—after all, who would bother with atrash who knows nothing?

But in the instant he turned around, the fleeting cold smirk at the corner of his lips was sharp as a blade.

Third Elder, Xuanwu Sect, Eyes of Heavenly Way... since you dare to touch people of the Chen family, then prepare for the backlash.

This debt, Chen Ji will collect, one item at a time.
